hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; ADB="$LOCALAPPDATA/Android/Sdk/platform-tools/adb.exe"; "$ADB" devices 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "device$" || exit 0; APK="app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk"; before=$(stat -c %Y "$APK" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); out=$(./gradlew.bat :app:assembleDebug -q 2>&1) || { echo "Auto-deploy: Gradle build xato:"; echo "$out" | tail -n 30; exit 2; }; after=$(stat -c %Y "$APK" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); [ "$after" = "$before" ] && exit 0; "$ADB" install -r "$APK" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Auto-deploy: adb install xato"; exit 2; }; "$ADB" shell am start -S -n com.bittada.bittadausta/.MainActivity >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
